name: Moray
title: Moray —
title_em: whisky, beaches and a sunny coast.
tagline: The heart of Speyside whisky and one of Scotland's sunniest coasts.
summary: Moray lies on the Moray Firth, between Aberdeenshire and the Highlands. It has more working distilleries than anywhere else in Scotland, including Glenfiddich and Macallan, and a long sandy coast.
Elgin has the ruins of a famous medieval cathedral, and the fishing villages along the coast are full of character.
